script.title: Stanford Prison Experiment ethics fallout explained
script.hook: Why did a fake prison shatter science?

scenes.text: Researchers locked students into roles for just a few days.

scenes.text: Guard aggression spiked, while prisoners showed stress signs.

motion_action.statement: Guard aggression spikes, prisoners stress rises

scenes.text: Psychologists later criticized the study for consent flaws.
The fallout forced new IRB rules on deception.
Today, ethics boards demand debriefs and withdrawal rights.
You can spot similar pressure in workplace drills.
Watch for sudden role shifts that silence dissent.
When authority cues intensify, your brain releases cortisol quickly.
